mapper.select: SELECT c.coach_id FROM fit_coach c JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id AND u.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.hire_status = '0' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_member m WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.member_status = 'normal'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_member_card mc JOIN fit_coach c ON c.coach_id = mc.bind_coach_id AND c.tenant_id = mc.tenant_id AND c.store_id = mc.store_id AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.hire_status = '0' JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = mc.member_id AND m.tenant_id = mc.tenant_id AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.member_status = 'normal' WHERE mc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mc.member_id = #{memberId} AND mc.bind_coach_id = #{coachId} AND mc.del_flag = '0' AND mc.card_status IN ('unused', 'active') AND (mc.expire_time IS NULL OR mc.expire_time >= NOW())
mapper.sql: plan_id, tenant_id, member_id, name, description, visibility, cycle_days, days_json, status, creator_id, creator_type, start_date, create_time, update_time, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fit_training_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND visibility = 'public' ORDER BY create_time DESC, plan_id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM fit_training_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND plan_id = #{planId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fit_training_plan (plan_id, tenant_id, member_id, name, description, visibility, cycle_days, days_json, status, creator_id, creator_type, create_time, update_time, version) VALUES (#{plan.planId}, #{plan.tenantId}, #{plan.memberId}, #{plan.name}, #{plan.description}, #{plan.visibility}, #{plan.cycleDays}, #{plan.daysJson}, 'draft', #{plan.creatorId}, #{plan.creatorType}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE fit_training_plan SET status = 'active', start_date = #{startDate}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 'draft'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fit_training_workout (workout_id, tenant_id, plan_id, member_id, sequence_number, day_number, title, original_date, planned_date, status, exercises_json) VALUES (#{workout.workoutId}, #{workout.tenantId}, #{workout.planId}, #{workout.memberId}, #{workout.sequenceNumber}, #{workout.dayNumber}, #{workout.title}, #{workout.originalDate}, #{workout.plannedDate}, #{workout.status}, #{workout.exercisesJson})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fit_training_workout WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY sequence_number
SELECT * FROM fit_training_workout WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND workout_id = #{workoutId}
mapper.update: UPDATE fit_training_workout SET title = #{workout.title}, exercises_json = #{workout.exercisesJson}, status = #{workout.status} WHERE tenant_id = #{workout.tenantId} AND workout_id = #{workout.workoutId} AND status IN ('planned', 'rest')

UPDATE fit_training_workout SET planned_date = DATE_ADD(planned_date, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND status IN ('planned', 'rest') AND planned_date >= #{fromDate}
UPDATE fit_training_workout SET performed_date = #{performedDate}, status = 'completed' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND workout_id = #{workoutId} AND status IN ('planned', 'completed')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fit_training_set WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND workout_id = #{workoutId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fit_training_set (set_id, tenant_id, workout_id, set_number, exercise_key, exercise_name, set_type, reps, weight, unit, weight_kg, rpe) VALUES (#{set.setId}, #{set.tenantId}, #{set.workoutId}, #{set.setNumber}, #{set.exerciseKey}, #{set.exerciseName}, #{set.setType}, #{set.reps}, #{set.weight}, #{set.unit}, #{set.weightKg}, #{set.rpe})
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM fit_training_set s JOIN fit_training_workout w ON w.workout_id = s.workout_id AND w.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY w.sequence_number, s.set_number

SELECT w.workout_id, w.performed_date AS date, s.exercise_key, MAX(s.exercise_name) AS exercise_name, MAX(CASE WHEN s.set_type = 'working' THEN s.weight_kg ELSE NULL END) AS max_working_weight_kg, SUM(CASE WHEN s.set_type = 'working' THEN s.weight_kg * s.reps ELSE 0 END) AS working_volume_kg, SUM(CASE WHEN s.set_type = 'working' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS working_sets, SUM(CASE WHEN s.set_type = 'warmup' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warmup_sets FROM fit_training_set s JOIN fit_training_workout w ON w.workout_id = s.workout_id AND w.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.plan_id = #{planId} AND w.status = 'completed' GROUP BY w.workout_id, w.performed_date, s.exercise_key ORDER BY w.performed_date, w.workout_id, s.exercise_key
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_training_workout WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 'completed'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fit_training_audit (audit_id, tenant_id, plan_id, member_id, actor_id, actor_type, action, detail, create_time) VALUES (#{audit.auditId}, #{audit.tenantId}, #{audit.planId}, #{audit.memberId}, #{audit.actorId}, #{audit.actorType}, #{audit.action}, #{audit.detail}, NOW())

INSERT INTO fit_training_media (asset_id, tenant_id, plan_id, file_name, media_type, size, create_time) VALUES (#{media.assetId}, #{media.tenantId}, #{media.planId}, #{media.fileName}, #{media.mediaType}, #{media.size}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fit_training_media WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND asset_id = #{assetId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fit_training_media_ref WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO fit_training_media_ref (tenant_id, plan_id, asset_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{planId}, #{assetId})
